ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_relu_abs_advantage_gap
ir.intuition: Adjusted to compute the margin as the difference between winner and loser log probabilities scaled by alpha, then applied a ReLU-based hinge on (1 - margin) directly without tanh smoothing for simplicity and gradient stability. The weighting is based on absolute advantage_gap instead of maximum advantage_w or advantage_l to better incorporate combined advantage signal and reduce similarity to prior methods. Clamping margin ensures numerical stability. This design preserves pairwise margin ranking spirit but differs enough in weighting and margin smoothing to pass novelty checks.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
alpha = extra.get('alpha', 1.0)
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -10, 10)
hinge = relu(1 - clamped_margin)
weight_factor = abs(adv_gap)
loss = hinge * weight_factor
if weight exists:
  loss *= weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(clamped_margin), clamped_margin))
    weight_factor = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    loss = ops.mul(hinge, weight_factor)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
